summary: On the web host, the landing page at "/" now shows only while the sign-in status is being checked or once the user is signed out. Signed-in users get the app, and failed or incompatible checks get their error pages. That fixes the stuck-on-landing problem from F1. The new temp test covers each sign-in outcome, protected paths, the desktop host, and the privacy and AI disclosures, so F2 is resolved and the change is ready.
